hook_text: The prepaid units ran out on a freezing Thursday night. Which appliance was the hungry one?
clip_script: Vryheid, a week of meter readings. Electricity isn't free: power stations, mines, pylons and workers all cost money, and we pay in units. So who ate the units? Not the phone charger, not the LED lights. The heat-makers! The geyser, the heater, the kettle. Save them: short showers, a geyser blanket, boil only what you need, warm jerseys, switch off at the wall.
visual_style: Whiteboard prepaid meter counting down, with appliances lined up from biggest to smallest user, and a checklist of savings.
mood: Detective work with a money-saving twist.
pacing: The mystery, the suspects, the culprit, then the fixes.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the watts label on three appliances at home.
